loads.source: 구조물팀 PPT slides 16–18, selected 14 m footing

scope: Ground mesh and material assignment at assembly

assumptions: c5.8kPa inferred at phi30 rho1200; not an independent triaxial fit
E11.48MPa nu.28 are shallow bulk wave estimates at40-80Hz, assigned to crust as proxy
not a measured static crust-only E; sensitivity0.5/1/2 required
top1cm dust omitted in prepared-surface reference; no vacuum/thermal or rate calibration
mars_insight_duricrust_proxy.name: mars_insight_duricrust_proxy

mars_insight_sand_jez1_dp_1300.role: InSight sandy-layer initial DP trial with low-density JEZ-1 shear parameters
assumptions: InSight target density and predicted 1 m wave speeds determine common initial elastic moduli
Apparent cohesion and peak friction digitized approximately from JEZ-1 at about 1380 kg/m3
Transfer to 1300 kg/m3 extrapolates the measured state; zero dilation and hardening are initial assumptions
Direct-shear normal stress 0.097–0.68 kPa; peak-envelope input differs from the Yin residual calibration
mars_insight_sand_jez1_dp_1300.name: mars_insight_sand_jez1_dp_1300

mars_insight_blocky_ejecta.role: coarse basaltic ejecta and brecciated regolith beneath the sandy unit
assumptions: Kenda Table 1 elastic parameters and Knapmeyer-Endrun Fig. 1 model density represent the bulk layer
Small-strain effective continuum with bonded interfaces; clasts and failure are unresolved
mars_insight_blocky_ejecta.name: mars_insight_blocky_ejecta

mars_insight_fractured_basalt.role: fractured basaltic bedrock beneath the coarse ejecta
assumptions: Kenda Table 1 fractured-bedrock elastic parameters and the terrestrial analogue density in Morgan Section 4.1
Effective shallow bedrock continuum; joint slip and failure are unresolved
mars_insight_fractured_basalt.name: mars_insight_fractured_basalt
